a: The `bar` marker is written as draw.io's `dash`, which is a diagonal slash, and `dash` reads back as a perpendicular bar
`absoluteArcSize=1` is ignored, so a rounded box is read as a stadium or round rect by the wrong measure
A shape the reader does not know is drawn as a round rect with no warning when its style also says `rounded=1`
The writer cannot tell a container from a pool, so a container holding one tall container reads back as a pool with one lane
A cluster whose members all sit in an earlier cluster is nested inside it and takes those members, though the earlier cluster should keep them
The `avoid` router is written as a plain orthogonal edge with no warning
An HTML label keeps literal newlines and runs of spaces, which the draw app collapses
A dragged connector label on a self-loop with no bends loses its offset without a warning
b: Draw-style XML claims only `.xml`, so the chart app's Import picker cannot choose a `.drawio` file
The writer's font style ignores `weight`, header rows, and every row after the first
An HTML label's literal newlines and runs of spaces are read as line breaks and kept, where the draw app collapses them
A `UserObject` label with `placeholders="1"` is read with its `%name%` placeholders unsubstituted
`absoluteArcSize=1` is ignored, so a rounded box with a pixel arc reads as the wrong outline
An empty pool is written as a swimlane the reader takes for a plain container
A moved edge label on a self-loop or zero-length line loses its offset silently
